referenceSources.description:
A striking red Toyota Supra A70 coupe is presented in a studio setting, showcasing its sleek 1980s sports car design. The vehicle’s pop-up headlights, smooth body lines, and integrated rear spoiler emphasize its aerodynamic profile and classic appeal. 

As part of the GR Heritage Parts Project by TOYOTA GAZOO Racing, reproduction components for the A70 Supra are now available for purchase. This initiative supports owners worldwide—both in Japan and overseas markets such as North America and Europe—by providing authentic replacement parts to maintain and restore these iconic vehicles.
